title: NOAA CoralTemp v3.1 SST has steps in 1995, 2002, 2008 and 2020 relative to in situ SST; without them the 1986-2025 reef heat-stress trend is about 30% smaller
abstract: Question: CoralTemp v3.1 is the daily 5-km SST record that NOAA Coral Reef Watch (CRW) uses for Degree Heating Weeks (DHW) and bleaching alerts. It joins the OSTIA reanalysis, the Geo-Polar Blended reanalysis and the near-real-time Geo-Polar analysis. Is it homogeneous, and how do its steps change reef heat-stress results? Approach: we reduced all 14,975 daily files (1985-2025) and compared CoralTemp with HadSST4.2 and ERSSTv5 (monthly, 60S-60N), DOISST v2.1 (daily) and up to 139 moored buoys. We used blind change-point searches, fixed-date step models with placebo dates, and daily dating. We fitted 5-degree step fields against the two in situ products and recalculated CRW statistics at 1,763 reef cells. Results: CoralTemp warms 0.033-0.040 C per decade faster than the in situ products in the tropics and reef boxes. The excess is a set of steps that all three references show: -0.03 to -0.08 C on 1995-06-03 (start of ATSR-2 data in OSTIA), +0.08 to +0.10 C on 2002-07-24 (start of AATSR data), +0.05 to +0.07 C on 2008-01-01 (change of the Geo-Polar bias reference) and +0.04 to +0.05 C near 2020-11-04. The 2020 step is four months after the DOISST step of 7 July 2020. The documented splice of November 2002 has no step. After correction the excess is -0.002 to +0.005 C per decade, also in cross-validation, and the buoy steps disappear. The correction raises the CRW climatology (MMM) by 0.14 C relative to current SST. The 1986-2025 trend of reef-mean annual maximum DHW falls from +1.12 to +0.78 C-weeks per decade (-30%; five variants -27% to -32%). The trend of the reef fraction with DHW >= 4 falls from +10.8 to +7.5% per decade, and in 2024 this fraction falls from 82.5% to 62.3%. Heat stress still increased strongly, and 2024 stays the maximum. Limitations: the references share data and the buoys are not at reefs; the causes of the steps are probable, not proven; 2013 and 2016 candidate steps are uncertain; fast variance is not homogenised; in a global bleaching database the corrected DHW separated bleached surveys slightly less well (AUC -0.009).

display.caption: Monthly CoralTemp v3.1 minus HadSST4.2 and minus ERSSTv5 (DOISST minus HadSST4.2 for context) at 30S-30N and in 5-degree boxes with reefs. Dashed lines: the four CoralTemp step dates. CoralTemp is too cold in mid-1995 to mid-2002 and steps up in 2002, 2008 and late 2020.

(a) Daily CoralTemp minus DOISST around the four step dates. (b) Median step relative to moored buoys (2 years after minus 2 years before) for raw CoralTemp, corrected CoralTemp and DOISST, with the 95% range at placebo dates (grey).

Reef heat stress at 1,763 reef cells: annual maximum DHW and reef fraction with DHW >= 4 for official CoralTemp (official CRW MMM) and step-corrected CoralTemp; their difference by year; and 1986-2025 trends of all variants as a percentage of the official trend (3-year block bootstrap intervals).
